messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.content:
At a pressure of 10 kPa (≈0.1 bar), the freezing point of pure water is essentially unchanged from its standard value.  
**Freezing point ≈ 0 °C** (the pressure‑induced depression is only on the order of 10⁻³ °C).
